risk_description:
The urea (Adblue) injection system may not function in low ambient temperature when the urea is frozen, due to insufficient performance of the heater inside the urea reservoir. As a result, there is a risk of vehicle emission levels to be
temporary out of regulatory limits.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
model_types: MPY121, MPY141, MPY161, MPY521, MPY541, MPY561, MPYA21, MPYA41, MPYA61
